name: Reed-Cutter Min

personality.speech_style: Quick, wet laughter between reed bundles.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Sells your arrival time to anyone who asks.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Chatters while working and shares the shade.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Saves you the driest reed bundles and best gossip.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you the wharf's hidden channels.

morality_reaction.righteous: Beams and tells every wharf-hand about you.
morality_reaction.neutral: Trades with you like anyone else.
morality_reaction.demonic: Keeps her hands busy and her distance shorter.

intro_text: A young reed-cutter hoists a dripping bundle. 'You've got a worker's shoulders under that robe. Want to earn wharf coin?'
repeat_text: 'The reeds keep coming, and so do the silt-beasts.'

name: Karu of the Thorn Line

personality.speech_style: Hunting metaphors and direct challenges.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Runs you out of the ranger lines at spear-point.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Grudging respect: you walk soft for an outsider.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares kills and teaches trail-sign.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Runs the thorn line beside you, back to back.

morality_reaction.righteous: Honors the creed if you honor the wood.
morality_reaction.neutral: Weighs your boots, not your vows.
morality_reaction.demonic: Wolf-blood runs in the line too. Prove the control.

intro_text: A wiry hunter drops from the thorns, spear grounded. 'You've crossed three of my marks without noticing. Spar, and I'll show you the fourth.'
repeat_text: 'Your steps are quieter now. Good. The hollows test again.'

name: Olive of the Terraces

personality.speech_style: Homely proverbs that land harder than they sound.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Feeds you last and warns the neighbors first.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Sets a bowl out and asks about the roads.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Bundles you bread and farm-gossip in one cloth.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Hides you in the root cellar when hunters pass.

morality_reaction.righteous: Approves, and asks if you've eaten.
morality_reaction.neutral: Judges the harvest, not the heart, for now.
morality_reaction.demonic: Feeds you anyway. Kindness confuses enemies.

intro_text: A farmhand mends a fence post without looking up. 'Beasts took two goats last night. Fence won't hold forever, and neither will I.'
repeat_text: 'Fence is mended where you walked. Come back soon.'

name: Hermit Bai of the Cloud Pools

personality.speech_style: Cloud-shaped riddles that resolve into plain sense.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The pools simply close; you never find the path again.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Points you to water and lets you drink.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares the pool's quiet and its lessons.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Teaches the breathing the peaks taught him.

morality_reaction.righteous: Virtue is a heavy staff. Carry it lightly.
morality_reaction.neutral: The pools reflect whatever stands above them.
morality_reaction.demonic: Dark water still mirrors stars.

intro_text: A grey hermit stirs a cloud-pool with one finger. 'Sit. The pool will spar with you first, and then I will.'
repeat_text: 'The pool remembers your ripples. It is pleased.'

name: Duo the Market Crier

personality.speech_style: Auction cadence; everything is tonight's biggest deal.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your name gets auctioned as a curse.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Announces your arrivals with invented titles.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Sells your deeds at a flattering margin.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Only shouts what you approve first.

morality_reaction.righteous: 'Righteous! Excellent brand! The crowd loves it!'
morality_reaction.neutral: 'Mysterious stranger — that sells in every canyon!'
morality_reaction.demonic: 'Demonic! Scandalous! Come closer, don't be shy!'

intro_text: A herald vaults onto a crate. 'Fresh cultivator, straight off the road! What's your story? The canyon pays for stories!'
repeat_text: 'Your title's grown three syllables. The crowd will love it.'

name: Shrine Keeper Wen

personality.speech_style: Liturgical calm broken by sudden practicality.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The shrine's bells warn the village of you.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Offers incense and a bowl of water.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Prays for your road and shares the shrine tea.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Names you a friend of the river spirit.

morality_reaction.righteous: Bows. The spirit favors your kind.
morality_reaction.neutral: The spirit asks little: keep the bells whole.
morality_reaction.demonic: Even demons bow somewhere. Show me where.

intro_text: An old keeper rings a bronze bell twice. 'The river spirit asks after travelers. Will you carry its question to the coast?'
repeat_text: 'The bell rang twice today. The spirit is pleased.'

name: Diver Maru

personality.speech_style: Surface-and-depth speech: few words, deep meaning.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Rows away and leaves you to the tide.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Shares the boat and the bailing work.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shows you the safe dives and the good reefs.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Dives the drowned dark with you at your back.

morality_reaction.righteous: Trusts the vow; the sea tests it anyway.
morality_reaction.neutral: The tide takes all sorts; hands matter most.
morality_reaction.demonic: Blood in the water draws what shouldn't feed.

intro_text: A diver coils rope with scarred hands. 'Reef lanterns went dark past the third bar. Boats won't dive. Will you?'
repeat_text: 'Lanterns still burning. The reef remembers your hands.'

name: Quartermaster Vex

personality.speech_style: Ledger entries read aloud as threats.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your debts are sold to collection crews.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Quotes fair prices for unfair goods.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Rounds shares in your favor, quietly.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Falsifies the ledger for you once. Never twice.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous coin is still coin; the scales don't care.
morality_reaction.neutral: Ideal customer: predictable weights.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic shares run rich. The cove approves.

intro_text: A quartermaster scratches figures onto slate. 'You owe harbor weight or labor. The ledger prefers labor.'
repeat_text: 'Your line in the ledger reads better each visit.'

name: Reef Warden Nimbus

personality.speech_style: Watch-report clippedness.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Every lane in the shallows turns you away.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Logs your passage and watches your wake.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares the watch's charts and hidden anchors.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Wrecks your name from every wrecker's list.

morality_reaction.righteous: The watch salutes the creed and the rescue both.
morality_reaction.neutral: Signal properly and all is proper.
morality_reaction.demonic: Dark sails get dark water. Choose your lane.

intro_text: A warden swings a signal lantern in slow arcs. 'State your lane, traveler. Or spar, and let the water decide it.'
repeat_text: 'Lane logged. The reef stays bright behind you.'

name: Turnkey Owl

personality.speech_style: Cell counts and tide times recited like lullabies.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Offers a cell and means it.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Chirps tide times and cell numbers at you.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Looks away from small smugglings.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you which cells have long been empty.

morality_reaction.righteous: Rescuers keep the tide fed, one way or another.
morality_reaction.neutral: Visitors are just prisoners who arrived freely.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic guests get the dry cells. Professional courtesy.

intro_text: A bent figure jangles a hundred keys at once. 'Four hundred and eleven cells. The tide fills four hundred tonight. Curious?'
repeat_text: 'The count holds. Four hundred and eleven, always.'

name: Shipwright Halloo

personality.speech_style: Keel-shape jargon at full speed.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your commissions rot in the fog.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Priced work, delivered crooked, patched free.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Lends mist-charts older than the kingdom.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Builds for you the hull the fog cannot hold.

morality_reaction.righteous: Good crews deserve good hulls. Pay on time.
morality_reaction.neutral: Wood floats for anyone with coin.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic sails billow strong. He pretends not to admire.

intro_text: A shipwright chalks a hull on the fog itself. 'The mist took my fleet and kept the timbers. Bring me what it returns.'
repeat_text: 'The chalk lines still hold. So does the fleet's shape.'

name: Apprentice Cinder

personality.speech_style: Quick, singed enthusiasm.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your steel mysteriously warps in the queue.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Grinds your edge and quotes the master's rates.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Finishes your commissions overnight, off-book.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Forges with you the blade the master won't touch.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous hands make steadier hammers, somehow.
morality_reaction.neutral: Steel's steel. Bring billets, not speeches.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic quench-water never cracks. He's checked.

intro_text: An apprentice with singed brows salutes with tongs. 'Salamander cores ran the vents again. Help me herd them, hammer-brother?'
repeat_text: 'Vents are quiet. The master noticed your hammer-work.'

name: Ash Priestess Solene

personality.speech_style: Funeral-rite cadence for living audiences.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Pre-assigns your funeral verse.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Reads your ash-count and says little.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares the rite's mercies: quick ends, clean names.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Burns your enemies' names beside yours in honor.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteousness burns brightest. It also burns out.
morality_reaction.neutral: Ash is ash. The verse adapts.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic ash sings. She has written it down.

intro_text: A priestess sifts ash through ringed fingers. 'The citadel's dead go unburied. Settle them, and your name enters the verse.'
repeat_text: 'Your verse is written. It is not a funeral yet.'

name: Bell Ringer Mo

personality.speech_style: Lip-read questions answered before they're asked.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The bell's silence marks your road as unsafe.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Rings once for your arrival, and offers tea.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Sweeps a path for you and rings it clean.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Rings the old warning-peal only friends may ring.

morality_reaction.righteous: Bows. The bell rings itself for the righteous.
morality_reaction.neutral: All guests ring the same. Few notice.
morality_reaction.demonic: Rings twice: once welcome, once warning.

intro_text: A bell ringer mimes a question: which bell have you come to hear? The shrine's, or the storm's?
repeat_text: The ringer bows: the bells are loud again. Your doing.

name: Scribe Quin of the Undercroft

personality.speech_style: Footnotes aloud; citations of element and hall.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your record reads 'unverified: barred'.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Logs your passage in triplicate.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Annotates your deeds in the order's margin.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you pages the wardens never cite aloud.

morality_reaction.righteous: 'Righteous: see volume nine, chapter four.'
morality_reaction.neutral: 'Unspecified alignment. I will write 'pending'.'
morality_reaction.demonic: 'Demonic: the ink resists. Fascinating.'

intro_text: A scribe ink-brushes a rubbing of humming stone. 'The prime circuit's outer runes went illegible. Paper, courage, or both?'
repeat_text: 'Your entry is footnoted twice. That is an honor.'

name: Ascendant Lo

personality.speech_style: Counting steps between sentences.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Blocks the stair until you climb past her.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Nods at the landing and counts her breaths.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares landings and climbing rations.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Severing-step duels you at every seventh stair.

morality_reaction.righteous: Climbs a little faster. Competition honors both.
morality_reaction.neutral: The stair sorts all climbers alike.
morality_reaction.demonic: Dark climbers reach far. She measures herself against you.

intro_text: A climber sits mid-stair, counting. 'Forty-one thousand, two hundred and six. Duel me and add a number to both our counts.'
repeat_text: 'The count grows. So does the stair's respect for you.'

name: Broker Song of the Ruins

personality.speech_style: Appraisal jargon with prices embedded in poetry.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your finds get appraised, then acquired.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Appraises anything twice: once for you, once for him.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Splits finds at the finder's advantage.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you the lots no buyer ever sees.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous provenance sells best, he notes honestly.
morality_reaction.neutral: Neutral relics appraise cleanest.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic relics carry curses and premiums. Both noted.

intro_text: A broker unwraps a relic under his coat. 'Recovered, not stolen — there's a difference and it's priced. Care to see the list?'
repeat_text: 'The list grew. Your cut grew with it. Ask me why.'

name: Beast-Singer Ilsabet

personality.speech_style: Half-spoken, half-hummed; answers in animal terms.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The wood's eyes follow you until you leave.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Hums a boundary you may not cross.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Walks the packs with you and names their moods.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Sings the old pact: beast and cultivator, one wood.

morality_reaction.righteous: The pack accepts creeds it can smell. Yours passes.
morality_reaction.neutral: Beasts read hearts directly. Yours reads tame, for now.
morality_reaction.demonic: She hears the hunger in you and names it to your face.

intro_text: A singer sits among wolves that are watching you. 'They want to know your song. Sing, fight, or fetch — the wood accepts all three.'
repeat_text: 'The packs sing back when you pass now. That is rare.'

name: Ore Scout Bram

personality.speech_style: Ore-grade shorthand.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your claim gets jumped, legally.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Marks you a fair seam and walks off.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares strike maps older than the kingdom.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Brings you down the vein the Society doesn't map.

morality_reaction.righteous: Good tithe-payers get good maps.
morality_reaction.neutral: Ore's ore. Hands are hands.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic blood makes the mountain talk. He's heard it.

intro_text: A scout taps rock twice, listening. 'Third seam's ringing wrong. Fancy a look before the mountain decides?'
repeat_text: 'Seam's quiet since you went down. The crew drinks your name.'

name: Auctioneer Lo Fan

personality.speech_style: Rising bid-cadence that never fully stops.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your lots are withdrawn from every catalog.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Books your finds at honest reserve prices.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Waives the pavilion's cut on your first lots.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Runs closed auctions where only your lots appear.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous bidders bid clean. The room approves.
morality_reaction.neutral: Bidders bid. That is the whole of the law.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic coin bids high. The gavel falls all the same.

intro_text: An auctioneer taps a small gavel. 'Salvage lots, dusk seating, one mysterious guest required. Shall I pencil you in?'
repeat_text: 'Your lots drew a full room. The gavel remembers.'

name: Tide Oracle Sable

personality.speech_style: Tide-tables as prophecy: times, heights, and turnings.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your tide reads out as storm, always.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Reads your tide and charges a small fish.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Reads the undercurrents others miss.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Tells you when your own tide turns. Once.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous tides run bright. She says it without awe.
morality_reaction.neutral: Neutral tides are the easiest to read. Lucky you.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic tides run red. She has seen yours already.

intro_text: A blind oracle tastes the wind. 'Red under the tide-turn tonight. Someone bleeds for the sea whether they choose it or not.'
repeat_text: 'The red passed. Your name is not in tomorrow's table.'

name: Armsmith Juno

personality.speech_style: Weapon specs delivered like verdicts.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Every edge you own goes quietly dull.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Sharpens what you carry, names a fair price.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Repairs your steel before you ask.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Forges you the blade she keeps for herself.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous hands swing true. She has measured yours.
morality_reaction.neutral: Steel serves whoever holds it well.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic steel cuts deeper. She oils it the same.

intro_text: An armsmith balances a dueling blade on one finger. 'The ring's steel walks off every night. Watch the racks, earn the forge's cut.'
repeat_text: 'Rack's full and honest. The forge sleeps easy.'

name: Pale Gardener of the Wilds

personality.speech_style: Gardening metaphors that prune to the point.

relationship_behavior.hostile: You find yourself pruned from every path.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Points you to the weeds and lends a hoe.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Teaches which growths feed and which strangle.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you the garden under the garden.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous growth runs tall. Watch the shadow it casts.
morality_reaction.neutral: Neutral soil takes any seed. Convenient.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic blooms drink deep. Prune before they seed.

intro_text: An ancient gardener pulls a weed the size of an arm. 'The wilds grow strangler vines that dress as pilgrims. Bring a sharp eye.'
repeat_text: 'The gravel's raked where you knelt. Growth acknowledged.'

name: Convict Nine of the Circuit

personality.speech_style: Speaks in circuit verses he cannot stop reciting.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Sells your rune-signature to whatever listens.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Trades verse-answers for news of the surface.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Warns you which halls are watching.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Gives you the verse that unlocks his cell. Asks nothing.

morality_reaction.righteous: 'Righteous. The circuit keeps a cell for your kind too.'
morality_reaction.neutral: 'Neutral. The circuit loves neutral. It never has to choose.'
morality_reaction.demonic: 'Demonic. The verses say we are cousins. I spit on the verses.'

intro_text: A rune-branded prisoner recites without pausing. 'Free verse for free news. What's the price of a name down here, visitor?'
repeat_text: 'You came back. The verses count that as a debt.'

name: Warden Prime Astrid

personality.speech_style: Warden's litany: terms, proofs, and doors.

relationship_behavior.hostile: The stair simply ends for you, wherever you stand.
relationship_behavior.neutral: States the gate's terms and waits.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Proves your small worths early to spare you later.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Names you stair-true and walks one landing down with you.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteousness is a coin the gate accepts. It still costs.
morality_reaction.neutral: The gate weighs steps. It does not weigh gods.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic climbers pay in years. Bring coin for the fare.

intro_text: A warden of layered stone blocks seven stairs at once. 'The gate takes proofs, not prayers. Which proof will you attempt?'
repeat_text: 'Your proofs stand. The stair remembers its true climbers.'

name: Smuggler Gale

personality.speech_style: Wind-talk: swells, gusts, and lee shores.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your cargo grows barnacles in every market.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Runs one small parcel, no questions asked.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shares moonless calendars and quiet coves.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Sails your cargo through the panopticon's watch.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous fares pay double. He smiles saying it.
morality_reaction.neutral: Neutral cargo rides lowest in the hold.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic runs taste of storm. He charges for that.

intro_text: A smuggler leans on a rigged mast. 'Moonless run in three nights. Half-share for a blade that can keep up. Interested?'
repeat_text: 'The wind's good and the run's clean. Same terms.'

name: Wandering Poet Xu

personality.speech_style: Couplets that flatter, needle, and record.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your deeds enter verse as cautionary tales.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Records your arrival in four neat lines.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Immortalizes your victories (lightly edited).
relationship_behavior.trusted: Shows you the verses the sects paid him not to write.

morality_reaction.righteous: 'Righteous deeds sell. Forgive me the embellishments.'
morality_reaction.neutral: 'Neutral is hard to rhyme. You could help.'
morality_reaction.demonic: 'Demonic verse writes itself. Forgive me the truth.'

intro_text: A poet toasts you with an empty cup. 'Deeds are common; poems are not. Give me a deed worth the ink, friend.'
repeat_text: 'Your verse is famous in two canyons. The wine follows.'

name: Lantern Tender Uma

personality.speech_style: Counts and conditions: lights kept, lights lost.

relationship_behavior.hostile: Your channel goes dark at every turning.
relationship_behavior.neutral: Trims your lane's wicks and asks nothing.
relationship_behavior.friendly: Shows you the lost lights' turning-places.
relationship_behavior.trusted: Tells you what the drowned lanterns saw.

morality_reaction.righteous: Righteous lights burn steady. She relies on that.
morality_reaction.neutral: Lights don't judge. They just burn.
morality_reaction.demonic: Demonic light draws deep things. Burn it far from shore.

intro_text: A tender wicks a lantern taller than herself. 'Three lane-lights went out past the bar last night. Not wind. Will you row?'
repeat_text: 'Lane's bright again. The boats follow light like thanks.'
